name: PHYSICS
title: PHYSICS: Benchmarking Foundation Models on University-Level Physics Problem Solving

ground_truth.type: list of one or more final answers

official_evaluation.problem_score: fraction of extracted boxed answers that match any reference final answer

notes: The canonical local data.jsonl in this pack is the 1000-problem official test split.
Validation (297), hard and text-only variants are also materialized when present.
Some tasks are multimodal; use tasks.jsonl to preserve the `graphs` field.
The local SymPy-only scorer is a development lower bound and is not leaderboard-identical.
The official hybrid scorer requires only a normal OPENAI_API_KEY; there is no PHYSICS-specific grader approval.
